# Trinath Kondapalli

> Senior UX/UI Designer & Design-to-Live Developer specializing in high-converting web applications, micro-interactions, and AI-accelerated workflows.

## Services

- [UX/UI Design](https://trinath-kondapalli.vercel.app/#services): User research, information architecture, wireframing, and design systems for web and mobile products.
- [Website Design & Development](https://trinath-kondapalli.vercel.app/#services): End-to-end design-to-live production builds using AI-accelerated workflows and Next.js / React.
- [Interactive & Motion-Led Web](https://trinath-kondapalli.vercel.app/#services): Code-based animations, page transitions, and micro-interactions using GSAP and Framer Motion.

## Selected Case Studies

- [NutriBox Case Study](https://trinath-kondapalli.vercel.app/case-study/nutribox): D2C wellness e-commerce platform redesign (+40% conversion rate).
- [LinguLink Case Study](https://trinath-kondapalli.vercel.app/case-study/lingu-link): Social language learning app (100k+ active users).
- [GoVigi Case Study](https://trinath-kondapalli.vercel.app/case-study/go-vigi): B2B agricultural logistics and bulk ordering portal (60% faster checkout).
- [FitTrack India Case Study](https://trinath-kondapalli.vercel.app/case-study/fit-track): 19-stage healthcare and fitness UX case study.
